### About this repository

This is the code behind [legesher.io](https://www.legesher.io). If something on the site looks wrong, reads awkwardly, or doesn't work in your browser or your language, this is the right place to tell us.

Looking for the engine, the language packs or the editor tools? They live in [legesher/legesher](https://github.com/legesher/legesher), and your language's words are shaped in [legesher/language-packs](https://github.com/legesher/language-packs).
